definition.name: Focused Rust entropy with separately authenticated native products

steps.name: Install the existing bounded compiler namespace and pinned bindings
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Authenticate historical sources and public products
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 6ffab636e647f93bfa12fda12a0383316f8dce8d e97d44ddc744c9bd738d9b3b7a7d8b7234133e36
python3 tools/replay_rust_standard_entropy.py --prepare --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-entropy-prepared"

steps.name: Test exact entropy source, ordinary transitive capture and retirement controls
Build owned entropy std and execute ordinary signed libraries
Retain bounded entropy observations including failed attempts

with.name: rust-entropy-focused-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-entropy-prepared/retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-entropy-prepared/host/host-retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/replay-materials.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/capture.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/outside/executable-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/entropy-std/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/entropy-std/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/approval-required/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/approval-required/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-standard-entropy/node/FAILED.json

reviewReason: Retain the entire normal captured executable closure, including compiler transitive build scripts and macros, for failed and passing focused runs.
